essence: Glow isolates pixels that pass a brightness/alpha threshold, spreads that extracted signal outward with a blur-like radius, then mixes the resulting halo back with the source. Lowering Glow Threshold admits more source detail into the halo; increasing Glow Radius makes the admitted light spread farther; increasing Glow Intensity strengthens the generated halo before compositing.
manifests_as: Bright qualifying areas bloom into a soft halo, potentially preserving, hiding, or differently blending the original artwork depending on compositing and operation modes.

key_levers.name: Glow Threshold
key_levers.effect: Sets the cutoff for source pixels that generate glow: lower values make more of the layer glow, while higher values restrict glow to the brightest or most opaque qualifying areas.

key_levers.name: Glow Radius
key_levers.effect: Controls how far the extracted glow signal spreads; larger values create a wider, softer halo and can make nearby glows merge.

key_levers.name: Glow Intensity
key_levers.effect: Multiplies the visible strength of the generated halo after thresholding and spreading; raise it for brighter bloom without expanding its footprint.

key_levers.name: Glow Based On
key_levers.effect: Chooses which source property is tested by Glow Threshold, changing whether visible color brightness or transparency drives where glow originates.

key_levers.name: Composite Original
key_levers.effect: Controls whether and how the unglowed source is retained relative to the generated halo; use it to decide whether the result reads as a glow overlay or glow-only output.

key_levers.name: Glow Colors
key_levers.effect: Selects whether the halo inherits source color, uses the Color A/Color B gradient, or uses an animated color-loop treatment.

key_levers.name: Effect Opacity
key_levers.effect: Mixes the entire Glow result with the untreated layer; reduce it to soften all Glow changes together after the look is established.

config_recipes.tight neon text: Glow Threshold 180, Glow Radius 18, Glow Intensity 2.5; keep Glow Colors at 1 for source-colored neon, then use Effect Opacity 70-100% to taste.
config_recipes.broad soft bloom: Glow Threshold 120, Glow Radius 90, Glow Intensity 1.5; retain the original through Composite Original and lower Effect Opacity to about 60-80% if the image washes out.
config_recipes.selective highlight bloom: Glow Threshold 210, Glow Radius 45, Glow Intensity 2; this confines the halo mostly to the hottest highlights while leaving midtones comparatively clean.
config_recipes.graphic two-color aura: Glow Threshold 140, Glow Radius 35, Glow Intensity 2; set Glow Colors to the unverified A/B-color mode, choose contrasting Color A and Color B, and adjust A & B Midpoint near 0.5.

reasoning_hooks: Threshold is the main eligibility gate: Radius and Intensity cannot create glow where the chosen Glow Based On signal does not pass the threshold.
Lower Threshold and larger Radius interact strongly: admitting midtones and spreading them widely quickly turns crisp artwork into a hazy wash.
Intensity changes halo energy, not its reach; use Radius for size and Intensity for brightness.
Glow Based On changes what Threshold means. A threshold tuned for bright RGB artwork may fail on an alpha-driven matte, and vice versa.
Color A, Color B, A & B Midpoint, Color Looping, Color Loops, and Color Phase matter only after Glow Colors selects the relevant non-original color mode.

Composite Original can make a correct halo appear missing or overly strong because it determines whether the source itself remains in the result; inspect it before compensating with excessive Intensity.
Effect Opacity is a final global mix control, not a substitute for Threshold: lowering it also weakens the retained original/composite result.
